title: Spark/Ash Semantic Manifest v0
description: A portable, serializable description of one Spark DSL module's declarative surface. v0 revision 2: rebased on Ash.Info.Manifest (ash v3.33.5, schema_version 1.0.0). The type algebra, field flags, pagination, multitenancy and named-type table below are Ash's existing IR as rendered by Ash.Info.Manifest.JsonSerializer; what this schema adds on top is source spans, stable structural symbol ids, three-digest hashing, provenance chains, and the accepted-vs-normalized split. See section 3 of docs/rfc/semantic-manifest-v0.md.

manifest_version.description: Major version only. Consumers may branch on this and on nothing else.

note.description: Free-form provenance note about this document itself (e.g. 'hand-authored fixture'). Never semantic.

abridged.description: True when symbols[] is a deliberate subset of the module's real surface. Emitters always set false; fixtures may set true.

toolchain.description: Recorded for diagnostics and for the invalidation key. NOT part of the compatibility contract; consumers must not gate on these.

debug_info.description: Whether Code.get_compiler_option(:debug_info) was true. When false, every span is null.

module_kind.description: Open-ended: unknown values must be tolerated.

symbols.description: Unordered, EXCEPT that symbols sharing a dsl_path appear in declaration order (semantically significant for policies).

ash_schema_version.description: The Ash.Info.Manifest.schema_version/0 of the IR this document extends, e.g. '1.0.0'. Present whenever the emitter layered spans onto an Ash-generated manifest; null for a pure-Spark DSL module with no Ash projection. Not a compatibility gate - see RFC 6.4.

types.description: Module-scoped named-type table, mirroring %Ash.Info.Manifest{}.types. Named type modules (Ash.Type.Enum implementations, Ash.Type.NewType subtypes, embedded resources) are hoisted here and referenced from typed slots by kind=type_ref, exactly as Ash already does. This is what prevents circular references (RFC 3.3, consolidation C2).

moduleName.description: An Elixir module name without the Elixir. prefix, e.g. 'AshEnterprise.Accounts.Team'.

atomName.description: An Elixir atom rendered WITHOUT the leading colon. Consumers must not call String.to_atom/1 on this; use String.to_existing_atom/1.

digest.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON form of a defined subset, truncated to 128 bits.

path.description: Repo-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths are forbidden (RFC 4.5).

role.description: declaration = the module's own source; fragment = a Spark.Dsl.Fragment; injector = a module whose __using__ macro contributed DSL. Open-ended.

inputs.description: The invalidation key: files + extensions_digest + toolchain_digest. Recomputable without compiling.

manifest.description: Digest of this document minus the hashes object. Integrity only.

span.description: Projected from :erl_anno.anno(). null whenever no annotation is available, which is the normal case when debug_info is off.

fidelity.description: exact = {line,column} start and an end location; start_only = column but no end; line_only = :erl_anno.location/1 returned a bare line; absent = should be represented as null instead.

propertySpans.description: Option name -> span, from Spark.Dsl.Entity.property_anno/2 and Spark.Dsl.Extension.get_opt_anno/3. Lets a diagnostic underline one option rather than a whole block.

stage.description: Open-ended; unknown stages must be tolerated.

by.description: The module responsible. null is legal and common: Spark records no attribution for Transformer.add_entity/4 today (RFC 4.6).

inferred.description: True when the emitter deduced this step heuristically (e.g. 'no anno and not in a declaring file, therefore transformer_added') rather than reading recorded attribution.

shape.description: Over the semantic payload with name, id, spans and provenance removed. Equal shapes across a remove/add pair in the same dsl_path is the rename heuristic (RFC 4.4).

content.description: Over the whole symbol minus hashes, span and property_spans. Moving a declaration must not invalidate a semantic cache.

type.description: A type term. The kind vocabulary and the property names are Ash.Info.Manifest.Type's (ash lib/ash/info/manifest/type.ex), extended with six kinds Ash's runtime-oriented IR does not need - literal, literal_union, behaviour, result, page, dynamic. 'dynamic' is always a legal answer and is the mandatory sink for anything the emitter cannot prove (RFC 5.2, 8).

kind.description: Open-ended. A consumer seeing an unknown kind must treat it as dynamic. The first thirty values are Ash.Info.Manifest.Type.kind/0 verbatim; the last six are added by this RFC for DSL-option and generated-boundary typing.

name.description: Human-facing type name, as Ash sets it (e.g. 'String', 'UUID', 'Array', 'TeamType'). Ash's serializer always emits it, so it is required here.

module.description: The Ash type module, e.g. 'Ash.Type.String'. For kind=behaviour it is the behaviour module.

allow_nil.description: Replaces v0 revision 1's separate `nullable` wrapper kind (consolidation C1): Ash already carries nullability as a flag on the type itself.

constraints.description: The Ash type's constraints, or the Spark option schema's, minus anything prohibited by RFC 8. Ash's IR carries these but its JSON serializer currently drops them; emitting them is an additive ask on Ash - provenance: proposed.

values.description: For kind=enum (Ash) and kind=literal_union (net-new). Finite and closed.

fields.description: For kind=map, struct, keyword. Replaces v0 revision 1's required/optional object pair (consolidation C1).

instance_of.description: For kind=struct: the struct module being wrapped.

open.description: For kind=map and kind=keyword: whether unlisted keys are accepted. Net-new; the accepted contract (RFC 5.3) needs it. provenance: proposed as an additive field on Ash's Type.

key_type.description: For a {:map, k, v} Spark option type.

symbol.description: For kind=type_ref: a symbol id in this or another module's manifest. Net-new alongside Ash's `module`, which stays authoritative when both are present.

value.description: For kind=literal. Floats are carried as their Elixir source string (RFC 7.2).

repr.description: Bounded inspect/1 output, for display only. Never evaluated, never parsed.

typedSlot.description: Every typed position carries both contracts. They are frequently different and that is the point (RFC 5).

accepted.description: What the public boundary accepts before casting/defaulting. Ash.Type.cast_input/2's domain.

normalized.description: What action code and callers receive after validation and defaulting.

name.description: null for symbols with no name field of their own, e.g. policies.

id_stability.description: ordinal means the id embeds a declaration position and will shift if a sibling is inserted before it.

previous_ids.description: RESERVED. provenance: proposed - absent in v0 emitters. For a future refactoring tool to record renames.

dsl_path.description: The Spark section path, e.g. ['attributes'] or ['actions','create','arguments'].

symbolUnknownKind.description: Forward compatibility: a v0 emitter may introduce a new symbol kind without bumping manifest_version (RFC 6.2). Such a symbol still carries the common base fields; its kind-specific body is unconstrained, and consumers are required to skip it rather than error.

struct_type.description: The loaded-record type this resource denotes.

embedded.description: Ash.Info.Manifest.Resource.embedded?. Embedded resources are types, not resources, and appear in an Ash manifest's `types` list rather than its `resources` list.

symbolResource.description: Mirrors %Ash.Info.Manifest.Resource{} (module, embedded?, primary_key, identities, multitenancy, description) and adds the DSL-level facts Ash's runtime IR has no reason to carry: domain, data_layer, authorizers. `name` on the base carries Ash's Resource.name.

options.description: Option name -> { value_repr, type }. Values prohibited by RFC 8 appear as a dynamic type with no value_repr.

ash_type.description: The Ash type module or shorthand as written, e.g. 'Ash.Type.String' or 'AshEnterprise.Accounts.Types.TeamType'.

default.description: null when there is no default. A non-data default (a captured function) is rendered as a dynamic type term, never as a value.

field_kind.description: The Ash.Info.Manifest.Field.kind this symbol projects to. Ash unifies attributes, calculations and aggregates into one Field struct; v0 keeps them as distinct symbol kinds because they are distinct DSL entities with distinct spans, and carries field_kind as the join key (consolidation C4).

filter_operators.description: Verbatim from Ash.Info.Manifest.Field.filter_operators. null iff filterable is false.

symbolAttribute.description: Projects to Ash.Info.Manifest.Field with kind=:attribute. The flag names are Ash's serialized names (allow_nil, writable, filterable, sortable, primary_key, sensitive, has_default, select_by_default). `generated` and the literal `default` are net-new: Ash records only whether a default exists, not what it is.

accept.description: From the action struct's :accept. null means 'not yet resolved to a list'.

argument_ids.description: Symbol ids of this action's argument symbols. Ash.Info.Manifest.Action.inputs is the flattened union of these arguments AND the accepted attributes; v0 keeps them apart because they have different spans and different provenance, and records the flattening in accepted_input / normalized_input instead (consolidation C5).

accepted_input.description: Open map. Keys include BOTH atom and string forms, matching the persisted {:action_inputs, name} MapSet (ash lib/ash/resource/transformers/cache_action_inputs.ex:28,53). Optional inputs are optional keys.

normalized_input.description: Closed map, atom keys, post-cast types, defaults applied.

required_inputs.description: From the persisted {:attributes_to_require, name}, minus anything with a default.

countable.description: Ash carries :by_default here as well as a boolean.

changes.description: Ordered. Module changes carry a module; inline/anonymous ones carry only a dynamic marker and a span.

get.description: Ash.Info.Manifest.Action.get? - a read action that returns one record.

metadata.description: Ash.Info.Manifest.Action.metadata: values the action attaches to its result. Carried in Ash's shape.

symbolAction.description: Projects to one %Ash.Info.Manifest.Entrypoint{} - Ash pairs {resource, action} at the app level, so the join key from an Ash manifest entrypoint to this symbol is "ash:v0:" <> resource <> "#actions/" <> action.name (RFC 3.5).

required.description: Whether a caller must SUPPLY this argument. Orthogonal to allow_nil, which is whether nil is a permitted value once supplied. Ash makes this distinction explicitly (see the Ash.Info.Manifest.Argument moduledoc); v0 revision 1 collapsed it into the action's required_inputs (consolidation C6).

relationship_type.description: has_many | has_one | belongs_to | many_to_many. This is Ash.Info.Manifest.Relationship.type; it is spelled relationship_type here because `type` is already taken by the typed slot (consolidation C7). The shape of a filter or sort over the relationship is derivable from cardinality, per Ash's Relationship moduledoc.

defines_attribute.description: Symbol id of the attribute a belongs_to implicitly defines (define_attribute? true).

calculation_kind.description: expression = expr(...) (carried as a dynamic term plus a span in v0); module = {Module, opts}.

expression.description: v0 always emits kind=dynamic with reason=ash_expression. The span is what a consumer shows.

filter_operators.description: Verbatim from Ash.Info.Manifest.Field.filter_operators. null iff filterable is false.

ordinal.description: Declaration position within the section. Policy order is semantically significant in Ash, so this is meaning, not just an id crutch.

condition.description: The policy's condition checks. An empty array means an unconditional policy (always()).

checks.description: Ordered authorize_if / forbid_unless / ... clauses. Order is significant: the first decisive result wins.

fields.description: For policy_kind=field_policy. '*' is rendered as the string '*'.

error_message.description: A literal string, or null. A function-valued error_message is never serialized (RFC 8.1); it appears as a dynamic type here.

opts_repr.description: Plain-data check options only. Anything prohibited by RFC 8 is dropped and reflected in 'opaque'.

target_module.description: The module the function is defined on - usually the domain.

variant.description: Which generated form this is. Derived from Ash.CodeInterface (lib/ash/code_interface.ex:1080-1180).

symbol.description: Symbol id in the resource's own manifest.

positional_args.description: From %Ash.Resource.Interface{args:}, in order. These are NOT settable via the params map.

from.description: A symbol id in this manifest.

to.description: A symbol id (possibly in another module's manifest, resolved lazily) or a bare module name.

kind.description: Open-ended; unknown kinds must be ignored, not rejected.

source.description: What produced it, e.g. 'spark.semantic' or a verifier module name.

typeFieldDescriptor.description: One entry of a map/struct/keyword `fields` list or a tuple `element_types` list. The shape is Ash.Info.Manifest.Type's field descriptor as serialized by Ash.Info.Manifest.JsonSerializer (name/type/allow_nil/description). `required` is the one net-new property: Ash's runtime IR has no notion of key presence, but the accepted-vs-normalized split (RFC 5.3) needs it. provenance: proposed as an additive field on Ash's descriptor.

name_repr.description: How the key is spelled at this boundary, per RFC 7.2 rule 5. 'atom_or_string' is the accepted contract of an Ash action: the persisted {:action_inputs, name} MapSet holds both forms (ash lib/ash/resource/transformers/cache_action_inputs.ex:28,53), so the key is listed once with this marker rather than duplicated.

allow_nil.description: Whether nil is a permitted VALUE. Orthogonal to `required`.

required.description: Whether the key must be PRESENT. Absent means unknown. An optional key is never modelled as required-and-nullable.

typeUnionMember.description: One member of a kind=union type. The shape is Ash.Info.Manifest.Type's union member (name/type/description, plus tag/tag_value for tagged unions - see ash lib/ash/info/manifest/generator/type_resolver.ex:233-262).

namedType.description: An entry in the module-scoped `types` table: a fully-resolved named type, not a reference. Same shape as `type`, but `module` is mandatory because the table is keyed by it - this mirrors Ash.Info.Manifest.type_lookup/1.

applicableExpression.description: Pass-through of Ash.Info.Manifest.ApplicableOperator / ApplicableFunction / ApplicableCustomExpression exactly as Ash.Info.Manifest.JsonSerializer renders them. v0 does not redefine the filter vocabulary; it carries Ash's resolved per-field values verbatim (consolidation C8).

symbolAggregate.description: Projects to Ash.Info.Manifest.Field with kind=:aggregate. Added in v0 revision 2 because Ash's Field already models aggregates; leaving them out would have meant a v0 consumer seeing fewer fields than the Ash manifest it is layered on (consolidation C4).

aggregate_kind.description: count | sum | exists | first | list | max | min | avg.

filter_operators.description: Verbatim from Ash.Info.Manifest.Field.filter_operators. null iff filterable is false.
